WIFI SMART SWITCH MODULE · WSM-09-2

Tuya WiFi 2 Channel Mini Smart Switch Module WSM-09-2

The ELVARO WSM-09-2 is a 2-channel mini smart switch module for adding WiFi on/off control to compatible lighting circuits. Its compact module format supports retrofit projects using an existing wall switch, subject to the available installation space and wiring compatibility.

2 ChannelsSwitching outputs
2.4GHzWiFi connectivity
App + VoiceSmart control
REQUEST A QUOTE →VIEW SPECIFICATIONS ↓
OverviewSpecificationsProduct Details

2-channel WiFi control for retrofit projects

Connect the module to a 2.4GHz WiFi network and manage connected lighting through Tuya Smart or Smart Life. Compatible Amazon Alexa and Google Assistant devices provide voice control, while timers, countdowns and schedules help automate everyday switching routines. Device sharing allows authorized users to access the module through the app.

The module requires a neutral wire and supports an external wall switch. Share your circuit count, load type and installation requirements with ELVARO to confirm the correct configuration for your project.
